import numpy as np

# Get poses and extents of both cubes
red_pos, _, red_extent = get_object_pose("red cube", return_bbox_extent=True)
green_pos, _, green_extent = get_object_pose("green cube", return_bbox_extent=True)

# Sample a grasp pose for the red cube and grasp it
grasp_pos, grasp_quat = sample_grasp_pose("red cube")
open_gripper()
goto_pose(grasp_pos, grasp_quat, z_approach=0.10)
close_gripper()

# Lift the red cube straight up
lift_pos = np.array(grasp_pos, dtype=float).copy()
lift_pos[2] += 0.15
goto_pose(lift_pos, grasp_quat)

# Compute placement: center of red cube should sit on top of green cube.
# Top of green = green center z + half green height; red center = top of green + half red height.
# The gripper grasp point is offset from red cube center; preserve that offset.
grasp_offset_z = grasp_pos[2] - red_pos[2]
place_z = green_pos[2] + green_extent[2] / 2.0 + red_extent[2] / 2.0 + grasp_offset_z
place_pos = np.array([green_pos[0], green_pos[1], place_z], dtype=float)

# Move above the green cube, then descend gently to the placement height
goto_pose(place_pos, grasp_quat, z_approach=0.10)

# Release the red cube only after it is resting on the green cube
open_gripper()

# Retreat upward
retreat_pos = place_pos.copy()
retreat_pos[2] += 0.10
goto_pose(retreat_pos, grasp_quat)
